baslik: The Volcano That Erupted During World War II

sahneler.metin: This volcano erupted in the middle of World War Two.
March 1944. Mount Vesuvius, Italy, the volcano that once buried Pompeii.
Allied troops had just taken the region from the Germans.
Then the mountain roared back to life.
Rivers of lava swallowed the villages on its slopes.
Falling ash destroyed dozens of American bombers at a nearby airfield.
Two whole villages were wiped off the map.
It remains the last major eruption Vesuvius has ever had.
The volcano that killed Pompeii is only sleeping.
